newsitem.title: UK: S&N unit to end Chelsea sponsorship.
newsitem.headline: S&N unit to end Chelsea sponsorship.

text.p: Scottish Courage, owners of the Coors lager brand, said on Thursday it would not renew its sponsorship deal this year with Chelsea Village Plc, owners of Chelsea football club.
"We have decided not to renew the deal which expires at the end of the season," a spokesman for Scottish Courage, a unit of breweries and leisure group Scottish & Newcastle Plc, said.

The spokesman declined to say how much the sponsorship deal was worth to Chelsea. He said a report in advertising industry magazine Marketing Week that the three-year contract was worth around five million pounds was wrong.
The spokesman said the companies were still talking about how to retain links and called their past cooperation a success.
He declined to comment on why Scottish Courage decided not to renew the contract.
Officials at Chelsea were unavailable for immediate comment.
